detail: Architectural appraisal 693 identifies the 1921 surviving block under its modern name Victoria Flats. It lists three storeys, red brick columns, paneled windows, ground arcade with voussoirs, central Venetian window and pediment, and a simple painted-brick rear.
Government heritage trail station 21 places the maternity block at 17 Barker Road and records the separate demolition of the old main building and conversion of the maternity block to flats.
Government medical heritage inventory records the maternity block as a Grade 3 historic building at 17 Barker Road.
The Lands Department publishes a 5 m raster under Hong Kong Principal Datum.
